claims.claim_text: Offline recommender conclusions are conditional on split, candidate, metric, aggregation, and tuning choices.
Naive sampled metrics can disagree with exact evaluation, while improved estimators remain distinct from exact metrics.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not claim all sampling is invalid.

claims.claim_text: Two-tower, Wide & Deep, graph, sequential, rule, and content methods contribute complementary assumptions rather than transferable superiority.

negative_constraints.rule: No architecture-age or source-native-score superiority claim.

claims.claim_text: Prior hybrid and rule-recommendation work motivates component fusion but does not test the proposed Apriori Wide estimand.

negative_constraints.rule: No claim that literature proves the Wide branch helps.

claims.claim_text: Repeat and exploration effects require explicit novel-behavior diagnostics beyond aggregate next-basket accuracy.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not equate aggregate gain with novel-item gain.

claims.claim_text: Content can provide item-side signal for cold items, but cold-item evidence does not imply cold-user effectiveness.
Vietnamese recommendation resources exist but do not expose the complete frozen v5 task and signal contract.

negative_constraints.rule: No first-dataset or no-dataset absolute claim.

claims.claim_text: External datasets exhibit a compatibility tradeoff between text/content and purchase/basket/session signals.

negative_constraints.rule: No silent pseudo-basket or missing-content substitution.

claims.claim_text: No reviewed external resource is unconditionally strict-H4-ready.

negative_constraints.rule: H4 remains NOT_TESTED if no candidate clears compatibility and rights gates.

claims.claim_text: Official reproduction and harmonized benchmarking answer different questions and must remain separate evidence families.

negative_constraints.rule: No pooled or cross-dataset raw score table.

claims.claim_text: The defensible research gap is the controlled joint evaluation of complementary signals under one protocol, not invention of the component methods.
All H1-H4 outcome claims remain NOT_RUN and cannot be inferred from literature.

negative_constraints.rule: No observed benchmark number or pass/fail result before sealed experiments.

manifest_negative_constraints.rule: No unqualified causal or superiority language.
No cross-dataset or cross-protocol raw metric comparison.
No Apriori/Wide effectiveness claim before H3.
No unconditional H4 eligibility or replication claim.
No 'first Vietnamese dataset' or 'no Vietnamese datasets' claim.
Keep ViHoRec and MUSE labelled as preprints.
Do not count RelBench adapters and their upstream datasets as independent corroboration.
Use 'train-mined rule-aligned evaluation cohort' if held-out outcomes determine membership.
No manuscript-ready citation without a non-null original-source locator.
